title: A flagged customer is internal at every location
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Use an organization with two locations, location A and location B.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer, with one asset, asset 1.
  • Work at location B.
custom_steps:
1. Click New Work Order.
  2. Pick customer A.
  3. Pick asset 1.
  4. Save the new work order.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The New Work Order window opens.

Step 2:

  • The "Internal" badge shows next to customer A.

Step 3:

  • Asset 1 is picked.

Step 4:

  • The new work order at location B shows the "Internal" badge.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11758 (Story 1, Turn on Internal Work Orders, flag internal customers, manage categories)

  • S1-E3: “If a shop has several locations, the toggle and the flag are organization-wide; a flagged customer is internal at every location.”
  • Key Decisions: “The setting is organization-wide, like every other Work Orders setting; Settings holds the toggle and a one-time turn-on modal; the Internal customer flag lives on the customer.”
